luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description:
A parent selector that can be used to distinguish between multiple instances of a component within a page.
This can be leveraged to create 1-to-1 mappings between {@link UITestComponent}s so that functions
called on a component are limited only to the scope of that component in the UI.

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

selfServiceDIPage.description: The selfServiceDIPage associated with this connector

messageBanner.description: The message banner component associated with this connector

connectorJson.description: The fetched json object for the connector SelfServiceDI.Ui.DataConnector

connectorName.description: The name to be given in the form for the connector

connectorDescription.description: The description to be given in the form for the connector

connectorCategoryTranslationKey.description: The connector category translation for the connector

connectorFormConnectorCategorySelector.description: The selector for the connectors catgory in the connector form

informationCardTitleSelector.description: The selector for the information card title

informationCardSubtitleSelector.description: The selector for the information card subtitle

errorInlineNotification.description: The error inline notification component associated with this connector

form.description: The overarching form component associated with this connector

landingPageConnectorNameAndDescription.description: The Defintion List component for the landing page associated with this connector

additionalCredentialFormErrors.description:
A list of objects of form input values and the expected error messages
to be used when verifying the form
[ {
 invalidCredentialFields: [ 'listOf', 'fieldNames', 'toBe', 'invalid'],
 errorMessageKey: 'Expected.key.of.error.message',
 assertionDescription: 'Specific description to be returned if the assertion fails'
}, ... ]

connectorFormSuccessCheckSelector.description:
The selector for the Successful checkmark icon in the connector form
when a test connection is successful

connectorFormSuccessMessageSelector.description:
The selector for the Success message in the connector form
when a test connection is successful

connectorFormLoadingSpinnerSelector.description: The selector for the button loading spinner in the connector form

backConnectorToSelect.description:
When testing that leaving the current connector and selecting a new, different connector clears the form
this is the connector to select

testConnectionSuccessMessage.description: The message to be displayed in the connector form when a test connection is successful

missingRequiredFieldsErrorKey.description: The key for a missingRequiredFields error in the connector form

incorrectRequiredFieldsErrorKey.description: The key for when there are incorrect required fields in the connector form

bannerSuccessMessageKey.description: The key for the succesful banner message after completing the connector form

bucketDropdownInputSelector.description: The selector for the bucket dropdown input in the connector form

bucketDropdownNewUrlSelector.description: The selector for the new url option in the bucket dropdown

regionDropdownSelector.description: The selector for the region dropdown caret
